title: dorycnium pentaphyllum subsp. amani
intro: Dorycnium pentaphyllum subsp. amani, commonly known as Aman's Dorycnie, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dorycnium pentaphyllum subsp. amani include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
